Messages.Author: Whisker
Messages.Body:
Hello!
Is Of Noble Blood a D action, when choosing Camarilla Vampire controlled by another methuselah?

Of Noble Blood
[Action] Action
[1 Blood]
Requires a ready primogen. +1 stealth action. Title.
Choose a Camarilla vampire with a capacity above 5 who does not have a title. Put this card on that vampire to represent the Camarilla title of primogen. Not usable on Caitiff.

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
When you choose or affect any cards controlled by other methuselah its a D-action. It doesn't need to have word "target". See the not-so-old rulings on  condemn the sins of the father (which was ruled a d-action).

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Correct.  means "typically directed"
If an action is directed at yourself, it's undirected.
If it's directed at someone else (or something controlled by someone else) it's directed "against" that Methuselah.

Prince of Paris, France
